name: lowcode-platform
description: A low-code platform with JSON schema to code generation

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/schema-contract build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/renderer build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/preset-antd build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/frontend build
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/schema-contract build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/renderer build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/preset-antd build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/frontend test run
scripts.test:preset-antd: pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/schema-contract build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/renderer build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/preset-antd test
scripts.test: pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:renderer && pnpm test:preset-antd && pnpm test:backend
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/schema-contract build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/renderer build && pnpm --filter @lowcode-platform/preset-antd build && pnpm -r type-check
